description: Local connector registry inspired by scientific AI workbenches. Entries may be local, planned, or external.

connectors.purpose: Parse, check, compile, export, and score Proto-like design files.
safety_notes: Runs locally.
Current DSL and exporters are development fixtures.

connectors.purpose: Provide reviewed or fixture part IDs for Codex/GPT design edits.
safety_notes: Current library is a toy fixture and must be replaced before real biological design.

connectors.purpose: Provide a versioned, external biological materials catalogue with bilingual descriptions, source/license evidence, content-addressed sequences, and a physically isolated quarantine store.
safety_notes: The external root is outside the workspace and is never copied into the repository or installer.
MCP can read only DESIGN_ELIGIBLE summaries and selected eligible sequences; quarantine is physically separate and admin-only.
Synchronization writes a staging snapshot and requires an explicit human activate/rollback action.
Design eligibility is a local data/license policy gate, not a claim of orderability, experimental safety, or regulatory compliance.

connectors.purpose: Retain NCBI accession.version references and third-party rights notices without placing unreviewed sequence data in the redistributable seed.
safety_notes: NCBI does not grant submitter or third-party rights; records remain conditional and reference-only until reviewed.
The accession.version form is required for stable provenance.

connectors.purpose: Expose Addgene source links without downloading, mirroring, or packaging content by default.
safety_notes: No Addgene sequence or plasmid data is fetched by the default materials synchronizer.
A user-provided approved credential and explicit compatible license are required before any future connector can read content.

connectors.purpose: Expose Proto Agent capabilities to MCP-compatible hosts such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex-like agents, and ChatGPT Apps.
safety_notes: Runs locally over stdio.
Every file argument is resolved beneath the declared workspace/build/cache roots with strict schema and byte limits.
Execution tools are disabled unless a digest-pinned OCI sandbox is configured; MCP cannot opt into unsafe host execution.
Live network tools require an explicit sidecar startup capability and otherwise use bounded cache or fixtures.
Tool outputs preserve structured diagnostics and human-review gating.

connectors.purpose: Turn workflow manifests into evidence cards, human-review checklists, and communication-ready review packets.
safety_notes: Review packets improve communication and auditability.
Workflow provenance is verified before evidence is consumed, and each review packet receives its own digest statement.
They do not certify wet-lab readiness, orderability, biosafety, or regulatory compliance.

connectors.purpose: Create, verify, and compare bounded SHA-256 provenance statements for workflow manifests and review packets.
safety_notes: Only single-link regular files inside workspace/build roots are accepted; symlink, junction, reparse, hardlink, duplicate, and self-reference claims are rejected.
Statements are content-addressed but unsigned and therefore do not establish publisher identity.

connectors.purpose: Exercise JSON, path, schema-envelope, and Proto parser boundaries with a pinned, checksummed corpus.
safety_notes: A source checkout defaults to tests/security_corpus; wheels and packaged workspaces must be given an explicit reviewed corpus path because that corpus is not bundled.
Runs in-process and offline with case, time, input, memory-observation, temporary-output, environment-restoration, and report-size checks.
Starts no child process and makes no network request, but cooperative timing is not an operating-system sandbox or hard preemption guarantee.

connectors.purpose: Import content-addressed Signature Evidence packs and verify Sigstore v0.3 artifact binding, cryptographic signatures, trusted time, pinned trust roots, and exact Trust Policy authorities without network access.
safety_notes: Verification uses a reviewed, digest-pinned Sigstore Public Good trusted-root snapshot and never performs a network fallback.
The connector cannot sign, generate keys, activate trust, authorize an effect, or rotate the pinned root.
A public-key signature without independently verifiable signed time remains incomplete even when its cryptographic signature is valid.

connectors.purpose: Import immutable seven-file TUF candidate packs and review sequential root rotation, dual signing thresholds, role expiry, rollback protection, target binding, and Sigstore trusted-root structure entirely offline.
safety_notes: Verification starts from a bundled digest-pinned root and checkpoint; it never performs a network refresh or trusts candidate metadata before both applicable root thresholds pass.
Version, expiry, length, SHA-256, delegated signatures, and rollback checks fail closed and remain separate from change classification.
The connector cannot download metadata, sign a root, generate keys, replace the pinned anchor, activate trust, suppress a failed check, or authorize an effect.

connectors.purpose: Import immutable six-file transparency witness packs and verify C2SP signed checkpoints, configured witness quorum, RFC 6962 inclusion and consistency proofs, rollback protection, and split-view evidence entirely offline.
safety_notes: The Rekor v2 log key is cross-checked against the installed Sigstore TrustedRoot; witness keys, quorum, and the starting checkpoint are release-pinned in an offline review policy.

Unknown signatures are ignored, while a configured matching key with an invalid signature, a future witness timestamp, a rollback, an equal-size different root, or an invalid Merkle proof fails closed.
The connector cannot fetch a checkpoint, contact a log or witness, submit an entry, sign or cosign a note, replace policy, advance witness state, suppress a finding, or authorize an effect.

connectors.purpose: Provide local, auditable source notes for workbench design rationale and future PubMed expansion.
safety_notes: This is a seed source registry, not a full literature review.
Scientific claims still require source verification.

connectors.purpose: Search PubMed through NCBI E-utilities with local cache and structured metadata output.
safety_notes: Network access is required for uncached live queries.
Cached and fixture modes are available for reproducible local runs.
Scientific claims still require source verification.

connectors.purpose: Search broader life-science literature metadata, including articles, preprints, patents, and database links, through Europe PMC.
safety_notes: Network access is individually approved and cached for reproducibility.
Returned metadata is evidence input and does not establish experimental validity.

connectors.purpose: Resolve and corroborate DOI-level publication metadata through Crossref.
safety_notes: Network access is individually approved and cached for reproducibility.
A DOI record confirms bibliographic identity, not scientific support for a claim.

connectors.purpose: Search reviewed UniProtKB protein and catalytic-function metadata without returning biological sequences.
safety_notes: Network access is individually approved and cached for reproducibility.
The connector returns identifiers and annotations, not sequences or wet-lab instructions.

connectors.purpose: Search curated biochemical reactions and cross-references through the Rhea REST API.
safety_notes: Network access is individually approved and cached for reproducibility.
Reaction records support software review but do not establish chassis feasibility.

connectors.purpose: Run workspace-local Python analysis scripts through a configured execution broker with captured output, artifacts, and a manifest.
safety_notes: Only Python scripts inside the workspace are accepted.
Execution is denied by default; normal operation requires a digest-pinned OCI image with no network and resource limits.
Unsafe host execution is available only through an explicit CLI flag and is not a sandbox.
Runs are captured under build/analysis by default.
This is a bounded analysis runner, not a full Jupyter server.

connectors.purpose: Run bounded Python cells from workspace-local .ipynb notebooks through a configured execution broker.
safety_notes: Lightweight runner only; does not start a full Jupyter server.
Only notebooks inside the workspace are accepted.
Execution is denied by default and requires a digest-pinned OCI sandbox for normal operation.
Runs are captured under build/notebooks by default.

connectors.purpose: Report R capability and run workspace-local R scripts through a configured execution broker.
safety_notes: Adapter is available even when Rscript is not installed; status reports runtime availability.
Only R scripts inside the workspace are accepted.
R execution is denied by default and requires a configured digest-pinned OCI sandbox for normal operation.
Runs are captured under build/r by default.

connectors.purpose: Export validated designs to a minimal SBOL3 Turtle profile and run local structural checks.
safety_notes: Runs locally without pySBOL3/SBOL-utilities.
Use pySBOL3/SBOL-utilities for full standards conformance before interoperability claims.

connectors.purpose: Validate assembled construct sequences against local GC-content and restriction-site constraints.
safety_notes: Runs locally and uses a small built-in recognition-site table.
This is a deterministic validation layer, not a full DNA Chisel optimizer.

connectors.purpose: Expose a DNA Chisel-style sequence optimization adapter with local reviewable suggestions and optional DNA Chisel backend detection.
safety_notes: Does not automatically rewrite biological sequences.
Uses local suggestions unless DNA Chisel is installed.
Optimization results require human review and policy-aware screening.
